svg.title: A·Spectra platform — solution architecture
svg.text: self-hosted single-tenant first, vendor-hosted SaaS second — one artifact
Same as author today; gains the
To be renamed; never a customer role
they already work: in the customer's
app host → frontend:8080 (static SPA) · api host → backend:8081 (REST /api, STOMP /ws-native)
HSTS · /swagger-ui, /v3/api-docs and /actuator/* (except health) answer 404 on the internet
Served by nginx in its container (port 8080)
TanStack Query server state · Zustand UI state
i18next: English, Spanish, French (2,517 keys each)
No AI logic, no provider key, no prompt (FE has none)
Primary flow: execution overlay; authoring IDE;
Spring Boot 3.5 · Java 21 virtual threads · hexagonal
10 bounded contexts + shared kernel + legacy model
REST problem+json · JWT, TOTP MFA, OIDC sign-in
Connectors, canonical model, review, launch, evidence,
result sync, dashboards, all AI (off by default)
Durable jobs with row claims · one outbox (G4, G5)
STOMP fan-out across instances via Postgres NOTIFY
Runs Core in its own JVM today (in-process)
resolved from lib/core-m2; tested commit pinned in core.ref
Fail-closed verdict (G20) · no AI, no TMS concept (G11)
Flyway forward migrations V1…V125 (+ U undo scripts)
Projects, scenarios, canonical cases and versions,
executions, step results, credentials, users, AI rows
Job rows: import, sync, AI jobs · execution outbox
Written by the backend. Today: files on its local disk;
HTML reports in a database column
Decided: S3-compatible object storage readable by every
instance, hashes verified on read (EVD-01, EVD-09)
Organisation as tenant (row-scoped) · one append-only audit trail · durable notifications (email + signed webhook)
Two instances: durable sign-in and MFA state, database-backed inbound rate limiter, zero-downtime deploys
Execution moves out of process onto the customer-side runner
TestRail — built, gated (offered-providers, FE list, landing copy)
Jira without Xray — in scope, not built
Backend imports cases and writes back one result per case + evidence
AI providers — opt-in, off by default
OpenAI-compatible adapter: hosted, or self-hosted (Ollama); batch adapter
Called only by the backend intelligence context (AI_ENABLED=false)
Federated sign-in: Google wired, any OIDC provider by configuration
SAML decided, not built · LDAP/AD out of scope
REST APIs: 6 auth schemes, JSON Schema, load and security steps
Web apps: Chromium, Firefox, WebKit through Playwright
Databases: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle (proven end to end)
Reached by Core from the backend host; private hosts denied in prod
Spring Boot app embedding Core · port 8090
Bearer AGENT_AUTH_TOKEN · wire v1, additive only
Core at core.ref, FE at fe.ref
Rules every repository follows: docs/architecture/repository-rules.md (R1–R16) · docs/development/engineering-rules.md (working rules, G1–G36) · git flow feature → develop → master
Scope source of truth: docs/alcance.md · numbered requirements: docs/requirements.md · deployment ownership: docs/deployment/README.md
GitHub Actions enabled (owner, 2026-10-20). Whether the VPS deployment is live is still to be confirmed.
The automation framework a team does not have to build: one runtime, several entry doors, evidence for every step
Verified against the code on 2026-10-20 · dashed = decided in alcance.md, not built
